summary: Sejarah Aktivitas + Pagination + Kelas filter + Logout confirmation stage fully verified. Backend: 7/7 new pytest cases pass in test_logs_and_kelas.py — GET /api/logs returns 401 without cookie, 200 with expected keys (Timestamp/User/Aksi/Detail) and includes recent 'Login' entries; GET /api/dashboard exposes 'kelas_list' (unique, sorted) and scopes total_aktif/gender/perhatian to a selected kelas; ?kelas=Semua matches no-param baseline; unknown kelas returns zero totals + empty perhatian. Frontend (single Playwright browser context, admin/admin123): nav-sejarah is enabled (class 'nav-link' only, no nav-link-disabled), routes to /sejarah, sejarah-table renders with newest-first order (first row 14 Sep 2026 00:20 Login). Aksi filter narrows rows to Login-only and Tambah Siswa-only. Setting sejarah-date-from='2099-01-01' shows sejarah-empty. sejarah-pagination-size defaults to 10, choosing 5 caps rows at 5 (info 'Hal 1 / 13 (62 data)' shown), prev disabled on page 1, next advances to Hal 2. Logout: nav-logout does NOT immediately log out — logout-confirm modal opens; logout-cancel closes it and keeps user on /sejarah; re-clicking nav-logout + logout-confirm-yes redirects to /login; visiting /sejarah while logged-out redirects to /login. Siswa: siswa-pagination-size options are exactly [5,10,50,100]; typing 'a' in siswa-search updates paginated total (7 → 6). Absensi: filter-status='Sakit' updates absensi-pagination-info to '(1 data)'. Dashboard: dashboard-filter-kelas options include 'Semua Kelas' + [6A, VIII, XI]; selecting 6A refetches /api/dashboard?kelas=6A and updates cards (hadir 3→2, laki 4→3, perempuan 2) and perhatian rows are all Kelas=6A; switching back to Semua Kelas restores originals (hadir=3, laki=4).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is now ~1462 lines — comfortably over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into src/pages/{Dashboard,Absensi,Siswa,Sejarah}.jsx, src/components/{Sidebar,Pagination,ProtectedRoute}.jsx, and src/context/AuthContext.jsx. Purely maintainability; nothing functional.

SejarahPage sorts logs client-side by string-compare on ISO Timestamp — correct because timestamps are UTC ISO8601. If backend ever changes format (e.g., localized), sort would silently break; consider a shared parseTs helper or server-side sort.

Backend /api/logs returns the full sheet on every request; with heavy log growth this becomes chatty (Sheets API is the bottleneck). Not urgent now (57 rows), but plan server-side pagination/date filtering when the log grows.

DashboardPage still passes tanggal=<browser-local-date> in one prior path (carried from iter5); the new /kelas path correctly OMITS tanggal, so this stage is unaffected. Consider also removing tanggal elsewhere to avoid TZ drift.
Home.exportCSV depends on 'filtered' which is defined below its declaration (works due to closure/hoisting via useCallback ordering, but subtle). Fine but worth a small refactor.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing ~62 rows in Log_Aktivitas (Login/Logout/Ubah Status Absensi/Tambah Siswa/Edit Siswa/Nonaktifkan Siswa/Aktifkan Siswa) and current active students (7 total across 6A/VIII/XI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend endpoints: GET /api/logs (auth-required) and GET /api/dashboard?kelas=<Kelas>. kelas_list now included in dashboard response. Frontend adds /sejarah route + logout confirm modal (data-testid: logout-confirm, logout-cancel, logout-confirm-yes). Reusable Pagination component pattern: `${testid}`, `${testid}-size`, `${testid}-prev`, `${testid}-next`, `${testid}-info`. All previous suites (auth, siswa, absensi, dashboard, generate/cron) still in /app/backend/tests and green. Login cookie is httpOnly+secure+samesite=lax; a single requests.Session or one Playwright BrowserContext is enough. Timestamps in Log_Aktivitas are UTC ISO8601; sort is client-side descending string compare.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects observed in this iteration.
